requirements.requirement: The system must define a provider_experience object in the provider detail response schema.
The system must include graduation_year as an optional integer field in the provider_experience schema.
The system must include enumeration_date as an optional ISO-8601 date field in the provider_experience schema.
The system must include derived_years_in_practice as a nullable numeric field in the provider_experience schema.
The system must include normalized_experience_score as a nullable numeric field bounded between 0 and 1.
The system must extend the provider detail response model to include the provider_experience object.
The system must ensure backward compatibility by not removing or renaming existing provider detail response fields.
The system must allow provider_experience fields to be null when source data is unavailable.
The system must serialize provider_experience fields in JSON format consistent with existing API response conventions.
The system must document the provider_experience schema contract in the service layer used by provider_detail_service.py.
The system must ensure enumeration_date values conform to valid date parsing rules and reject malformed formats.
The system must handle the exception case where both graduation_year and enumeration_date are missing by returning null for derived_years_in_practice and normalized_experience_score.
The system must handle the exception case where enumeration_date is in the future by treating it as invalid and setting derived fields to null.
The system must ensure the provider_experience schema is accessible and interpretable by downstream LLM components without additional transformation.
The system must use semantically clear field names that align with LLM reasoning expectations (e.g., years_in_practice, experience_score).
The system must ensure normalized_experience_score is explicitly labeled as normalized to prevent LLM misinterpretation as raw years.
The system must avoid embedding business logic in the schema definition beyond field naming and typing.
The system must ensure consistent ordering of provider_experience fields in the response for deterministic parsing.
